technical.summary: Mixed signals with long-term bullish structure (50/200 SMA, supertrend) but weak intermediate momentum, negative money flow, and overbought stochastic RSI create moderate entry risk.

fundamental.summary: GD shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 19 days present timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed signals with one large purchase ($250k-$500k) offset by sales
sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buying opportunity; congressional activity shows modest conviction with one significant Democratic purchase 123 days ago, but recent trades are mixed and aged.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (351.84), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, NFP event today, and earnings binary in 19 days create compounded downside risk for GD.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (50/200 SMA bullish, supertrend bullish) with extreme market fear (29/100) creating contrarian opportunity and congressional buy signal provides asymmetric risk/reward setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), high earnings risk in 19 days, negative money flow, price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, and zero fundamental support create compounded downside risk that outweighs technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme market fear (29/100) and long-term bullish structure (50/200 SMA, supertrend) present contrarian appeal, the combination of high earnings risk (19 days), severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve), and zero fundamental support creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs potential upside.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary in 19 days combined with VIX crisis environment and negative money flow could trigger sharp drawdown before technical structure has time to prove out.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical score (6) insufficient to overcome fundamental (2), sentiment (4), and risk (2) headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already 29 positions in Industrials sector; adding GD would increase concentration risk without conviction support.
